subject: Demo coverage needed: EU roadshow + upcoming Thanksgiving blackout
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo coverage needed: EU roadshow + upcoming Thanksgiving blackout

Team —

Quick heads up: I’m on the road for a partner roadshow in London from Oct 20–24 (partner dinners + back-to-back meetings) and will be largely offline between Oct 19–26 local time. On top of that, we’ll have the company Thanksgiving blackout Nov 27–30 which will compress demo capacity in the weeks around it.

I’ve pulled the next 10 scheduled demos that fall inside those windows — two are high-touch product walkthroughs (FinLedger & Atlas Health), three are discovery calls where discovery > demo, and the rest are qualification/demo combos. I’m asking for coverage and a short reschedule plan:

- Lauren: can you own FinLedger (10/22 10:00 AM BST) and Atlas Health (10/23 09:00 AM BST) demos? Those need someone who can speak to routing and failover.
- Marcus: can you triage the compliance-sensitive calls (SentryBank, OakBridge) and propose alternative dates if the compliance reviewers are out?
- Monica: please take the EMEA morning slots (08:00–11:30 BST) and handle calendar invites + recording setup.

Attached: coverage-playbook.pdf (short checklist for handoffs), mutual-action-plan-FIN-234.docx (FinLedger MAP), and a proposed-times.ics I exported from my calendar with my blocked travel slots.

Please reply with assignments by EOD PT so I can message customers and either requeue or introduce the covering AE/SE. If anyone is slammed, call out which slots you cannot cover and I’ll look for backup.

Thanks — aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo coverage needed: EU roadshow + upcoming Thanksgiving blackout

Got it — I can pick up FinLedger and Atlas Health. A couple of quick notes:

- I’ll run FinLedger’s demo on Oct 22 10:00 AM BST. Marcus, can you join for the brief compliance Q&A at the end (10–15 min)?
- For Atlas, I’ll focus on routing failover and caching behavior; I’ll use the ‘playbook’ checklist and record the session.
- I’ll send invites to both customers today and add Monica on the invites for recording + notes.

Also flagging that I’ll be at RSA for two days (Oct 27–28) so I’m not fully available that week — but that doesn’t overlap the above.

Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 12:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo coverage needed: EU roadshow + upcoming Thanksgiving blackout

Thanks — I’ll take the compliance-heavy calls. Two items:

1) SentryBank’s compliance lead told Aditya yesterday they’re out Oct 21–24 (GxP reviewers travel). We should either reschedule SentryBank for the week of Nov 3 or run the demo without the complete compliance review and schedule a 30-min follow-up with their reviewer.
2) OakBridge has requested an earlier slot (they’re prepping for internal budget reviews). I can move my calendar to open up Oct 19 morning PT (evening UK) if needed.

I’ll update the MAPs and post a recommended reschedule matrix in the HubSpot deal.

—Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Perez <susan.perez@finledger.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Oct 2025 08:05:00 +0100
Subject: Proposed new times for our 22 Oct demo (FinLedger)

Hi Susan —

I’m excited to walk through the Redwood demo next week. One thing I want to flag up front: I’ll be traveling in London Oct 20–24 for a partner program and will have intermittent connectivity. To make sure you get a great, uninterrupted session, Lauren (cc’d) will run the demo in my place on Oct 22 at 10:00 AM BST. If that exact slot no longer works for you, would any of the following alternatives be better?

- Wed Oct 22 08:00–08:45 BST (earlier)
- Thu Oct 23 09:00–09:45 BST
- Mon Oct 27 14:00–14:45 BST

Lauren is familiar with your account and will cover routing/failover and the live quantization example you asked about. Monica will handle the recording and follow-up notes.

If none of these work, tell me a couple of times that suit your team and we’ll prioritize. Apologies for the short notice — I wanted to be proactive instead of risking a no-show.

Best,
Aditya

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Susan Perez <susan.perez@finledger.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2025 14:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Proposed new times for our 22 Oct demo (FinLedger)

Aditya — thanks for the note and for the intro to Lauren. We can do Thu Oct 23 at 09:00 BST — that works for the compliance and infrastructure folks.

Please share the updated invite and recording permissions for any internal attendees who may need access. Looking forward to the session.

Regards,
Susan Perez
Product Lead, Integrations
FinLedger
